title: eludite.search.find output
description: The matches grouped by file, the counts Visual Studio's count line shows, and whether the search stopped early. Without `query` (the person's key) the dialog opened and the answer is `dialog: true` with no matches.

search_id.description: This search, for eludite.search.results and eludite.search.cancel.

files.description: The matching files, sorted by path, each with its matching lines.

path.description: The file, relative to the workspace's folder with `/` when it is inside it, else absolute.

open.description: Searched from an open document's buffer (its unsaved text).

matches.description: Its matching lines, in line order.

column.description: The first match's column on the line, 1-based, in characters.

text.description: The line without its line ending. A line longer than 1000 characters is cut around its first match, and `…` marks the cut ends.

ranges.description: Where the matches are in `text` (every match on the line).

before.description: With `context_lines`: the lines just before, oldest first.

total.description: Matches found (several on one line count each).

files_searched.description: Files read (binary and too-large files are skipped and not counted).

truncated.description: The search stopped at `max_results`: there are more matches.

canceled.description: Stopped by eludite.search.cancel (the Find Results window's Stop), or replaced by a newer search in the same window: the matches found until then.

results_window.description: The Find Results window that shows the results.

dialog.description: The Find in Files dialog opened (no `query`); nothing was searched.
